social_activities:
Actively engaged in social service for nearly 45 years.
In 1992, was arrested on the same day as Honorable Shri Lal Krishna Advani Ji and remained in Ranchi Central Jail for one month. .
On December 6, 1992, had the honor of serving as a Kar Sevak in Ayodhya.
Namo Book Bank - Over 3.64 lacs books have been distributed so far through this initiative.
Namo Toy Bank - Operated under the guidance of Honorable Prime Minister Shri Minister Narendra Modi Ji, this initiative has distributed over 80,000 toys to Anganwadi centres in remote rural areas of Jharkhand.
Namo e-library and cyber peace community centre in Ranchi, aimed at enhancing digital literacy and cyber security skills among youth. This initiative is dedicated to empowering every section of society through access to global knowledge and technological education, contributing towards a developed India by 2047.
interests: Organizing (i) Socio cultural & Political events, ii) Events like seminars, Discussion etc. on economic issues; upliftment of economic activities
hobbies: Listening to music, visiting places of interest, watching movies
